g.text: Behind her, a clean desk held an untouched page.
Chapter Two | The Perfect Far End
She called this planning, because planning felt like movement.
A checklist offered three louder answers.
Chapter Four | Naming the Near Edge
The beginning feels too far away.
Chapter Five | A Plain First Plank
Then she wrote herself a small reason to come back.
On the desk, the untouched page had become a beginning.
By sunrise, Mira was standing on the other side.
